content.bridge_context: We move from telling time to calculating duration and converting between units of time (Seconds, Minutes, Hours).

units.title: Time Conversions
units.explanation: 1 minute = 60 seconds. 1 hour = 60 minutes. 1 day = 24 hours.
units.dual_language_instruction: Convert hours to minutes. / घंटों को मिनटों में बदलें।

units.title: Elapsed Time
units.explanation: Calculating how much time has passed between a start time and an end time.
units.dual_language_instruction: Calculate the duration. / समय की अवधि की गणना करें।
